slot.brief: Evaluate a 3x3 determinant using row/column operations (splitting a row as a sum) and factor the result

stem: Evaluate the following determinant by splitting its third row as a sum and using determinant properties: $$\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\1&3&6\\7&19&52\end{vmatrix}$$

verdicts.working: Split the third row as \((7,19,52)=7(1,1,1)+(0,12,45)\). By linearity in that row, the first determinant has two identical rows and is zero. The remaining determinant is \(1(135-72)-1(45)+12=30\).

working:
$R_3=(1,9,36)+2R_2+4R_1$.
$$D=\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\1&3&6\\1&9&36\end{vmatrix}=(3-1)(6-1)(6-3)=30.$$

Independent check: Split the third row as \((7,19,52)=7(1,1,1)+(0,12,45)\). By linearity in that row, the first determinant has two identical rows and is zero. The remaining determinant is \(1(135-72)-1(45)+12=30\).
solution:
Write $R_3=(1,9,36)+2R_2+4R_1$. By linearity in the third row, the terms involving $R_2$ or $R_1$ give zero determinants because they repeat a row.
$$D=\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\1&3&6\\1&9&36\end{vmatrix}=(3-1)(6-1)(6-3)=30.$$
